status: Implemented for independent review. Functional/numerical/bounded accessibility checks pass. Historical sustained performance and real AT/device acceptance remain open. Stop before any next phase.

proofs.scope: Exact linked finite mathematical models, not TypeScript/floating-point/sampling/whole-game verification.

museum.guide: native Play/view/paint and keyboard alternative; confirmed destructive replay; clean skip/finish
museum.storage: minimal optional preference; blocked writes tested
museum.sourceChecks: exact spatial/mood/terrain/controller continuity on reading and replay cancellation

rendering.note: Isolated synchronous Canvas2D rendering at 600x600; not physical/wall throughput, compositor time or sustained FPS.

Final source pair, unpaired minute and census-asserted four/Bell runs use final app source. Census fields added later are absent from earlier endpoint records.
interpretation: Final matched source pair 0.69961 before / 0.70482 after misses historical ~0.965 absolute target in both arms. Unpaired final minute 0.97918 and near-real-time bounded UI probes do not erase adverse data or establish sustained acceptance. Cause of fast/slow regimes unresolved; no claim that all regressions are environmental. Kernels/step policy unchanged.
